limitations: Fixed small pilot, not standard CFF ChiChi competence or a general language model.

Experimental word bridge is explicit in compiler inputs/phenotype; it copies raw bits to shared native readouts, not token meanings. Foundation assets alone do not carry this profile; no promotion or existing-brain migration is supported.
Actor-only supervised foundation learning across fresh cohorts; no same-individual optimizer rebase or critic update.
Recorded lifetime/fast offsets, memory and route context remain fixed during conditional replay; recurrent prefixes are rebuilt under current weights for every update.

Subjects pass native hearing/association/motor developmental gates through ordinary world ticks before neural capture. No natural-sleep retention trial; sleeping ticks within ordinary assessment are reported without forcing sleep.
Default uses a deterministic bounded teacher translator; a real SLM delivery is claimed only with confirmed optional llama.cpp receipts.
Fresh-process reload covers exact private state, next eight native steps and the next native Adam update using a retained real gradient; it does not retrain the gradient after reload.
